title: AWKUM Announces Transport Registration for Spring Semester 2026
text:
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM) has officially commenced the Spring Semester 2026 from
February 09, 2026
.

Students who wish to avail themselves of the
AWKUM Transport Facility
are requested to log in to their
MIS accounts
and register for their respective routes.

Registration Period:
February 09, 2026 – February 20, 2026

Important:

Students who were registered for transport during the Fall Semester 2025 must reapply for the Spring Semester 2026.

Transport registration will be processed on a
first-come, first-served basis
.

Available Routes (Outside Mardan – Alphabetical Order):

Bakhshali, Charsadda, Fazad Abad, Gaddar, Gujrat, Hakeem Abad, Hathian, Katlang, Lund Khwar, Mian Khan, Muhib Banda, Nowshera, Rajjar/Kuladher, Rustam, Sardheri/Gul Abad, Sawaldher, Sher Garh, Shewa Adda, Swabi, Takht Bhai, Umerzai/Turangzai/Utmanzai, Yar Hussain.

For further information, students may contact the Transport Office at:

📞 Phone:
0937-920875 (tel:0937920875)
